name: Cuyahoga Community College
tuition_note: In-county (Cuyahoga County resident) tuition & fees $139.54/credit hour for 2026 (Summer/Fall 2026) from tri-c.edu tuition-and-fees page; annualized as 30 credit hours (15/semester x 2) = $4,186.20, rounded to $4,186. Rate combines instructional fee ($120.04) + general and technology fee ($19.50). Housing: none published - Tri-C is a commuter community college with no on-campus dormitories/residence halls listed.
